cast.side_why: no cast shadow - the render wall runs 210-248 right up to the frame and is brightest in the last 10 px before it

peephole.x_why: no peephole - the whole face was read at 1.1x crop and the only fittings are the pull bar and the black cylinder rose

hinges.side_why: bar and cylinder are on the right so the hinges are on the left, but the left reveal is a flat 44 px shadow with no knuckles at 1.6x

extras: brass inlay strip running the middle two thirds of the black pull bar
recessed porch: frame face is a 90 px flat casing on both sides
bristle mat in a steel tray on the sill
notes: Deepest and most symmetric frame in the set: a box lining with a 90 px flat face and a 44-46 px return on BOTH jambs, plus a 60 px head soffit at tone 0.23. The shot is square-on, so near and far reveal differ by 2 px and the near/far split is nominal - do not read asymmetry into it. Handle is unusual: a flat matte-black bar 0.86 of the leaf height with a brass strip inlaid down its centre, set at x 0.81, inboard of the cylinder rose at x 0.95. Leaf aspect is 1.96, so this is a wide (about 105 cm) leaf, not a standard 90.
